name: ChatPress.ai – The Simplest AI Chatbot for Your Website
author: chatpress

sections.description:
ChatPress is the AI chatbot plugin for WordPress that focuses on one thing: making setup simple and results fast.

  • Trained on Your Website: Your chatbot answers questions using content already on your site—no manual uploads or complex integrations.
  • Ridiculously Easy Setup: Install the plugin. Paste one API key. Select your pages. Done.
  • No Developer Needed: Skip the tech headaches. ChatPress is built for solo site owners, nonprofits, and small agencies.
  • Flat, Transparent Pricing: Simple monthly plans. No add-ons. No hidden fees.

Who Should Use ChatPress?

  • Solo WordPress Site Owners: Run your own site? Get chatbot help live in minutes.
  • Small Agencies: Deliver smarter sites faster, with less client setup.
  • Nonprofits & Community Groups: Make it easier for visitors to find information without needing a big tech team.

How ChatPress Stands Out

  • Truly WordPress-Native: Unlike generic chatbot platforms, ChatPress installs as a real WordPress plugin.
  • No AI Training Hassles: Select the pages you want it to learn from. No CSV uploads or extra work.
  • Smarter Without Bloat: No complex dashboards. No feature overload. Just a clean, usable chatbot.

Try ChatPress.ai Today

Ready to enhance your WordPress website with an AI-powered chatbot? ChatPress.ai makes it easy to integrate ChatGPT-driven conversations into your site, providing real-time, automated engagement for visitors.
✅ Instant Setup – No coding required.
✅ Affordable & Transparent Pricing – No hidden fees.
✅ Designed for WordPress – Native plugin, built specifically for your site.
🚀 Get started with ChatPress.ai today and transform the way your website interacts with visitors!
sections.faq:
Is there a free plan?

Yes! Sign up, create your chatbot, test it. And subscribe for a paid plan once you are happy. You get 1 free chatbot that can be trained with maximum 3 pages and we offer 30 messages to test your trained chatbot.

What type of content is used to train chatbot?

You can select any public pages and posts from your WordPress website. We use WordPress API to fetch your page data. The API is enabled by default in WordPress. If you have disabled it then make sure your API access is enabled for public pages and posts.

What happens when my usage quota is over?

We will email you once you have reached 80% of your usage. You can choose to upgrade to continue using the AI. If you do not upgrade once the quota is over, the AI will respond with a message “ChatPress AI is unavailable now. Please contact youremail@yourcomapny.com”

Where is my data stored?

We use Open AI to create embeddings from your data and store it in a database hosted on AWS located in EU (Frankfurt) server

How many websites can I put my chatbot on?

You can put the chatbot on as many website as you wish as long as you are within the message quota limit.

screenshots.caption: Create an account - Visit chatpress.ai to create a free account.
Install & activate the plugin - Download the plugin for WordPress and activate it using your API key found inside your dashboard.
Create your chatbot - Give your chatbot a name, provide it with instructions, customize its appearance, and more!
Train your links - Select the pages you want to train your chatbot on.
Publish your chatbot - Once you’ve finished training, preview and then publish your chatbot directly on your WordPress website.
